description: Repairs r-fmt-2-pres-1/scalar-admission: the date 2958466 was labelled out-of-range but was accepted as the upper endpoint, and the overflow side was never probed. Asks the admission of VT_DATE values through a table-type recordset into Dt.Ft, one row per value (DBEngine.Errors after the put and the update): 2958465.99998843, 2958466, 2958466.5, 2958467, 10000000 at the upper end, and -657434, -657435, -700000 at the lower end. Typed values are read back; one image after all of them. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes its mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
